body.name: Fixed-query independent-calendar subclass
body.construction:
For each fixed admissible query \(z_0\), define
\[
 \mathcal M^{\mathrm{iid}}_{N,T,\mathbf n}(z_0)
 =\left\{\xi=(\mathbb K_\xi;\mu,m,\Sigma)
 \in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}(z_0):
 (X_{s1},\ldots,X_{sT})\text{ are independent under }\mathbb K_\xi
 \text{ for every }s\right\}.
\]
Only the design dates are required to be independent.  Responses may remain
arbitrarily dependent across dates within a unit history, and the common
observable-sigma-field decision-rule convention of
\texttt{def:fixed-query-kernel-class} continues to apply.
